problem: External intelligence existed, but coverage was narrow in the portal and catalog capability, evidence, company-specific impact, action and learning were not presented as one explicit lineage.
decisions: Extend the existing Powerhouse evidence spine; never create a parallel intelligence database.
Maintain a broad source catalog separately from observed evidence so a possible source is never shown as connected truth.
Use one taxonomy for 35 external and 10 internal business domains.
Keep raw observations immutable and derived classifications/scores in separate projections.
Never invent monetary impact. Impact remains unknown until company exposure, probability and magnitude are evidence-backed.
Reuse the existing runtime scheduler mux instead of adding another cron writer.
Derived action candidates are recommendations only; canonical execution/outcome authorities remain unchanged.
Register the entire lineage in Loop Assurance so missing outcome/learning evidence cannot be reported GREEN.
Only READY candidates with a SCORED evidence-backed company impact may be materialized into the canonical Brain obligation authority.
lineage: source -> evidence -> signal -> company impact -> recommendation -> canonical action -> readback -> outcome -> measurement -> learning -> guard
inheritance: All future source/connector work should first map to powerhouse_intelligence_source_catalog_v1.
All future external intelligence should reuse bg_signaal_onderwerpen/bg_externe_signalen and the canonical source observation spine where applicable.
All portal surfaces should expose evidence status and unknowns rather than optimistic defaults.
New intelligence loops must reuse the central scheduler/control plane unless a documented authority exception exists.
Future intelligence actions must use powerhouse_materialize_intelligence_action_v1 or an explicit successor; direct provider execution from a signal projection is forbidden.
